import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sales by Product
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = data.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax1.bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color='#8B4513', alpha=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by Time of Day
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
time_sales = data.groupby('time')['total'].sum()
ax2.plot(range(len(time_sales)), time_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#D2691E')
ax2.set_title('Sales by Time of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Time')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(time_sales)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(time_sales.index, rotation=45)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
payment_counts = data['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors_pie = ['#CD853F', '#DEB887']
ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Sales by Customer Age Group
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
age_sales = data.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()
age_order = ['18-24', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = age_sales.reindex(age_order)
ax4.barh(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color='#A0522D', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_title('Sales by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax4.set_ylabel('Age Group')

# 5. Quantity Distribution by Product
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
product_qty = data.groupby('product')['quantity'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax5.bar(product_qty.index, product_qty.values, color='#8B7355', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_title('Total Quantity Sold by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Product')
ax5.set_ylabel('Quantity')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
takeaway_sales = data.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
ax6.bar(labels, takeaway_sales.values, color=['#BC8F8F', '#D2691E'], alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# 7. Price Distribution by Size
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
for size in size_order:
    size_data = data[data['size'] == size]['price']
    if len(size_data) > 0:
        ax7.scatter([size] * len(size_data), size_data, alpha=0.6, s=100)
ax7.set_title('Price Distribution by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Size')
ax7.set_ylabel('Price ($)')

# 8. Average Transaction Value
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
avg_transaction = data['total'].mean()
metrics = ['Avg Transaction', 'Max Transaction', 'Min Transaction']
values = [data['total'].mean(), data['total'].max(), data['total'].min()]
ax8.bar(metrics, values, color=['#8B4513', '#D2691E', '#CD853F'], alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_title('Transaction Metrics', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

# 9. Summary Statistics
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.axis('off')
summary_text = f"""
SUMMARY STATISTICS

Total Sales: ${data['total'].sum():.2f}
Total Transactions: {len(data)}
Avg Transaction: ${data['total'].mean():.2f}

Most Popular Product:
{product_sales.index[0]}

Peak Hour: {time_sales.idxmax()}

Total Items Sold: {data['quantity'].sum()}
"""
ax9.text(0.1, 0.5, summary_text, fontsize=11, verticalalignment='center',
         family='monospace', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.3))

plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
